146.editorialReason: Bishop routes to d1 to block its own Rook, permits Kxb1, then discovers mate. Complex positional Rook sacrifice with four solver moves; not a non-sacrificial C* line.

147.editorialReason: Pawn check, equal Knight/Bishop exchange, Rook underpromotion avoids pat, final rank mate. Five solver moves, no net sacrifice.

148.editorialReason: Queen check redirects King, then capture-promotion to Knight mates through a crowded cage. Earlier discovery start excluded: Qxe4+ is a simpler material-winning candidate.
